helper_proposal:
Proposed helper and input contract (proposal only; not implemented)

Add a small generic ScoreBoundary validation helper before fixed-history export.
The adapter supplies the observed value kind (logits/logprobs), exact native API
and row mapping, full unpadded vocabulary size, native/storage/normalization
dtypes, effective request settings, model-defined scale/softcap, and output-
affecting transforms with applied/identity status plus boundary evidence.

Example fields:
score_semantics = {value_kind: logits, vocabulary: full_unpadded,
 boundary: model_output_before_sampling_transforms,
 native_dtype: float16, storage_dtype: float32,
 normalization: {operation: log_softmax, dtype: float32, log_base: natural},
 transforms: [{name: temperature, value: 1.0, effect_on_returned_scores: identity},
              {name: repetition_penalty, value: 1.0, effect_on_returned_scores: identity},
              {name: vocabulary_truncation, effect_on_returned_scores: absent}],
 boundary_evidence: {kind: native_hook_or_verified_identity_path,
                    API: exact_native_entrypoint, source_hash: pinned_source_hash}}

Reject unknown boundaries or any score-affecting nonidentity sampling transform
when a raw-score contract is requested. Keep sampling selection (e.g. top_k=1)
separate from transforms affecting the returned row; do not infer rawness from
an output_logits flag alone. A small default-versus-explicit-neutral probe can
detect transformations like this exact FP16 division by temperature 0.8. Do not
silently invert or renormalize away truncation/masking or call the result raw.
Keep model-defined scaling/softcapping as part of the model score definition.
